title: Come Thou Fount Of Every Blessing
lyrics: Verse 1:
Come, Thou [D]fount of every [A]blessing, Tune my [G]heart to [A]sing Thy [D]grace;
Streams of mercy, never [A]ceasing, Call for [G]songs of [A]loudest [D]praise.
Teach me some me[G]lodious [D]sonnet, Sung by flaming [G]tongues a[D]bove;
Praise His name, I'm fixed u[A]pon it, name of [G]God's re[A]deeming [D]love.
Verse 2:
Hither[D]to Thy love has [A]blest me; Thou hast [G]brought me [A]to this [D]place,
And I know Thy hand will [A]bring me Safely [G]home by [A]Thy good [D]grace.
Jesus sought me [G]when a [D]stranger, Wandering from the [G]fold of [D]God;
He to rescue me from [A]danger, Bought me [G]with His [A]precious [D]blood.
Verse 3:
Here I [D]raise mine Ebe[A]nezer; Hither [G]by Thy [A]help I [D]come,
And I hope, by Thy good [A]pleasure, Safely [G]to ar[A]rive at [D]home.
Jesus sought me [G]when a [D]stranger, Wandering from the [G]fold of [D]God;
He to rescue me from [A]danger, Inter[G]posed His [A]precious [D]blood.
Verse 4:
Oh, to [D]grace how great a [A]debtor, Daily [G]I'm cons[A]trained to [D]be;
Let Thy goodness, like a [A]fetter, Bind my [G]wandering [A]heart to [D]Thee.
Prone to wander, [G]Lord, I [D]feel it, Prone to leave the [G]God I [D]love.
Here's my heart, oh take and [A]seal it, Seal it [G]for Thy [A]courts a[D]bove.

Praise His name, I'm fixed u[A]pon it, name of [G]God's re[A]deeming [D]love.
